scope: E0/E1 no physics; E2 original acquisition source-group mechanism; no new layout, no Full66 probability training
prior: original Gaussian64 x Uniform2 pushforward, Gaussianized66
white: sqrt2/sigma, source-major Re32 then Im32; material real Hilbert norm /24

anchor.DEV: historical Full Native96/Probit64 x from original raw cache; rerun endpoint only to own live LU, fully billed
anchor.LOCKED: measurement-only direct Gaussianized Probit TRF from zero x, objective Phi+||x||²/2
anchor.fallback: best finite observed objective from same history; all failures retained; no GT restart

material_geometry.selection: minimum eigenvector K^T K+T^T T on effective material frame; beta=1; excludes numerical decoder kernel, NOT exact Maxwell-null
material_geometry.strong_frame: up to8 joint material-normalized top response directions orthogonalized against chosen material direction
material_geometry.prior_cost_gate: report both with and without this explicit reasonable-prior heuristic; not posterior mass

arms.A_FROZEN: shared weak direction, exact decoder distance matching, frozen full-J predictor/corrector
arms.B_FULLJ: same weak direction, dynamic full-J GN, all material-effective correction coordinates except signed progress, exact distance retraction
arms.C_JETS: same weak direction, exact decoder+Maxwell jets2/3 in common top8 strong coordinates, same dynamic full-J corrector
arms.D_RANDOM: frozen seeded native-normal random projected off strong frame, same RMS/progress and dynamic full-J corrector

correction.endpoint_selection: lowest Phi+.5||x||² among distance/progress feasible paid states, no GT

all_three_terms: decoder curvature and Gaussianized property derivatives
jets.group_compensation: separate group-A/group-B and joint coefficients at same lower-order material path; explicit real LS
jets.exact_order_claim: none from rank threshold, report nonzero first order and finite-noise crossover

numeric_gates.first_physical: three central steps JVP, adjoint identity and jet check; error signal must exceed solver floor
numeric_gates.jet_validity: two adjacent radii; 0.02 required for task-scale advantage
numeric_gates.path_selection: all12 parents: B_FULLJ latent chord to radius.02 and C_JETS raw cubic at radius.02, no success selection
numeric_gates.physical_endpoint_noise_ball: original 95% circular Gaussian noise ball; separate ΔPhi<=2 competitive heuristic

tasks.T2: fixed right-half ROI mean |chi-host|², NOT GT risk or Bayesian risk
tasks.T3: ROI fraction of cells Re(chi)>=0.75 and event fraction>=0.25; genuine material function

resource_forecast.remaining_budget_gate: derivative/solver contract passes, locked paired comparison and required paths remain under unchanged frozen arms/radii; no new learned branch

statistics.main: C vs B at.02 paired endpoint Phi, competitive material success, paid RHS; all methods report Pareto
statistics.confidence: descriptive parent percentile95%; no large-population conclusion, no source/node pseudoreplication

isolation: data-generation process writes private GT and public y separately; online runner cannot load offline_truth; all eight predictions seal before scoring
attachment_conflicts: current task replaces proposed rotated new acquisition with original8-source disjoint groups
current task requires online GT isolation; locked centers are reconstructed from observations, not known truth
standing user public existing-B1 preference retained; attachment no-publication default is not an active instruction
